description: It's all about the innovation. Acer products are designed for your needs and accessibility with powerful features fit for your lifestyle. The Aspire Lite packs a lot of power into the portable design to suit the multi-tasking needs of you and your family. Break the boundaries of performance every time you fire up Acer’s new Aspire Lite, which features the latest AMD Ryzen 3 Series processor and faster Wi-Fi 6 connectivity for an awesome computing experience. This finely tuned design offers unmatched speed and reliability, making it ideal for things like photo and video editing, gaming, and work-related functionality. The narrow-bezel design provides plenty of screen so you can focus on what's in front of you, while the Full HD IPS display ensures crisp, true-to-life colors! With Windows 11 Home, you’ll experience fast start-ups, a familiar yet expanded Start menu, and great new ways to get stuff done. And with automatic updates enabled, you get all the latest features and security hassle-free. Work, play and share all in one device!
